title: Pharmacy Care Coordinator - Clinical Pharmacy Operations
description:
Job Description
A bit about this role:
Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.
Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

• Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)

• Virtual pharmacist-led or clinician-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps

• Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies

This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:

• SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)

• SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)

• MTM (Medication Therapy Management)

• TCC (Total Cost of Care)

• Polypharmacy

During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.
As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission-driven, team-oriented, joyful culture.
Responsibilities and Impact will include:

• Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns

• Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options

• Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions

• Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation

• Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits

• Participates in sprints, pilots, and special projects as they launch

• Collaborates with the broader pharmacy team to support shared goals and coverage needs

• Assists with training and shadowing when new team members join the team

• Participates in team and pharmacy department activities and responsibilities

Required skills and experience:

• At least 3 years of work experience in health care or retail pharmacy

• Active National PTCB Certification

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies

• Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently

• Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

Desired skills and experience:

• Highly organized and detail-driven

• Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve

• Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively

• A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates

• Comfortable speaking with physicians, pharmacies, and patients, with a genuine passion for our members

• Thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Preply scales its AI-powered learning platform, we’re looking for an experienced Senior ML Platform/Ops Engineer to help productionize machine learning systems with high reliability, performance, and observability.
You’ll work at the intersection of ML, data engineering, and cloud infrastructure enabling fast, secure, and reproducible model development from training to deployment.

We’ve reached 90%+ adoption of AI coding tools across engineering, and we’re now moving towards more autonomous, AI-Augmented development at scale. At Preply, engineers have direct access to the best tools available, with the freedom to use them fully and experiment as they build.

You’ll collaborate closely with ML Scientists, Backend Engineers, and Data Engineers to shape the foundations of our ML lifecycle.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment using tools like Databricks, MLFlow, Airflow, DBT, Sagemaker, Tecton

- Support AI scientist creating reproducible, containerized model training environments (on-demand and scheduled), and manage compute at scale (e.g., spot/GPU autoscaling)

- Define and implement observability and alerting for ML systems (model drift, data quality, feature coverage, etc.)

- Design and scale data ingestion and feature transformation flows using batch (e.g., Spark/BigQuery) and streaming (Kafka or equivalent)

- Contribute to internal Python libraries and platform tooling that accelerate experimentation and deployment for all model teams

- Ensure ML services are modular, testable, and monitored from day one

- Exploration and productionization of LLM-based features (e.g., retrieval pipelines, prompt evaluation, model serving)

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience designing and deploying ML systems in production (5+ years in relevant roles)

- Proficiency in Python and SQL, and orchestration tools (Airflow, Kubeflow, Dagster, etc.)

- Experience with modern cloud platforms (preferably GCP or AWS), Kubernetes, and CI/CD workflows

- Understanding of ML model lifecycles: training, validation, deployment, and monitoring

- Strong DevOps practices: Git, IaC (Terraform), logging/observability, containerization (Docker/K8s)

- Ability to work independently with ML Scientists and mentor peers in reliability, testing, and delivery. Product impact driven.

- Exposure to LLM serving, vector databases, or GenAI-powered product flows

- Deep, hands-on expertise in AI tools, especially in agentic AI SDLC

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT AT PREPLY

- An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

- A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com http://preply.com/, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

- A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

- Access to free mental health support platforms;

- The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

title: Senior New Business Manager
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals - bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production’s proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding - clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

• Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation

• Define the pitch narrative, positioning and “red thread”, ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout

• Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver

• Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses

• Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content

• Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings

• Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response

• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities

• Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated

• Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities

• Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

• Monitor competitor activity and industry trends

title: Payroll Specialist- Temporary
description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and compliance-focused Payroll Specialist to join our Finance team on a temporary basis to support a high-priority initiative involving the creation of a new US LLC, the wind-down of the existing US Branch, and the end-to-end implementation of a new global payroll provider. This role will work closely with the Finance, Legal, and People Operations teams to ensure seamless execution across all project workstreams. You'll collaborate with external advisors, payroll vendors, and internal stakeholders to meet regulatory deadlines and ensure compliance at every stage. This role reports to the Senior Global Payroll Manager.

StackAdapt is a Remote First company, we are open to candidates located anywhere in Canada for this position.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Support the payroll and compliance workstream for the US Branch to US LLC transition.

• Assist with deregistration and final filings for the existing US Branch across ~36 state and local jurisdictions.

• Execute state and local payroll tax registrations for the new US LLC.

• Assist with payroll setup, tax configuration, testing, and initial processing under the new entity.

• Collaborate with internal teams (Tax, Legal, HR, Finance) and external partners (ADP, tax agencies) on transition deliverables.

• Track deadlines, dependencies, filings, registrations, and open items throughout the transition and identify and escalate risks or compliance gaps.

• Support the payroll implementation workstream for the migration of StackAdapt's entities to a new global payroll provider following the US LLC transition.

• Support  implementation activities including data preparation and migration, payroll configuration, integration coordination, validation, testing, parallel payroll runs, issue resolution, and go-live readiness.

• Coordinate with the global payroll provider, internal stakeholders, and payroll teams across multiple countries to ensure implementation milestones and dependencies are met.

• Maintain detailed project documentation, payroll requirements, testing results, issue logs, and implementation sign-offs.

• Support a controlled transition to the new global payroll provider while maintaining payroll accuracy, compliance, and business continuity throughout the migration.

What You'll Bring to the Table

• Knowledge of US payroll, payroll tax, and multi-state compliance requirements.

• Experience managing payroll projects, implementations, entity transitions, or similar initiatives.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage timelines, deadlines, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders.

• Highly detail-oriented, accountable, and thorough, with a strong focus on accuracy and follow-through.

• Proven ability to take ownership of complex work from planning through execution, identify risks early, and proactively drive issues to resolution.

Sobre a oportunidade
Você vai transformar dados de demanda, ocupação e comportamento de compra em modelos que precificam uma malha com milhares de pares origem-destino e rotas multi trecho - um problema de revenue management cientificamente rico, com inventário perecível de assentos, sazonalidade forte, no-show e tetos regulatórios. É um papel centrado na descoberta: formular hipóteses, validá-las com rigor estatístico e mover receita e margem na escala de milhões de viagens por ano.

• Elasticidade e disposição a pagar - estimar elasticidade-preço e willingness-to-pay por segmento e rota, base para a otimização de preço.
• Revenue management em rede - modelar proteção de assentos e alocação de capacidade (fare buckets) em rotas multi-trecho, equilibrando ocupação e receita.
• Experimentação causal - desenhar testes A/B e inferência causal que validam mudanças de preço e medem uplift real, com critérios estatísticos claros de promoção.
• Explicabilidade e confiança - garantir interpretabilidade (ex.: SHAP) para defender cada preço perante o negócio e o regulador.
• Cold start e calibração - desenhar estratégias para rotas com pouco histórico, partindo de priors de literatura e evoluindo para ML, por tenant.
Você é a ponte entre ciência e produto: colabora com ML engineers no caminho até produção, com data engineers na disponibilidade dos dados, e com as áreas comercial e de operações na definição das metas.

Linguagem & libs: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), XGBoost, LightGBM

•
Estatística & ML clássico: EDA, modelos estatísticos, regressão, classificação, clustering

•
Deep learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow

•
Causal & temporal: séries temporais/forecasting, inferência causal (ex.: EconML, DoWhy), bayesiano/hierárquico

•
Revenue management & otimização: elasticidade, fare buckets / seat protection, programação linear

•
Experimentação, MLOps & dados: A/B testing, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray Tune; SHAP, SQL, sobre Athena

Essenciais
• Formação quantitativa sólida (Estatística, Economia, Matemática, Engenharia, CC ou afim) e base robusta em probabilidade, inferência e desenho experimental. • Análise exploratória de dados (EDA) e forte capacidade de storytelling e visualização.
• ML clássico (regressão, classificação, clustering) e séries temporais; familiaridade com deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow).
• Python e o ecossistema de Data Science (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels); SQL para dados em larga escala.

• 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems

• Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs

• Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes

• Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We define how AI systems are represented in telemetry (spans, traces, token usage, cost, eval signals, etc), and ensure that data from diverse ecosystems (e.g., LangChain, OpenLLMetry, Braintrust) is normalized into a consistent OpenTelemetry-based model.

Support and own your software in production. You'll participate in on-call rotations to ensure reliable operations and proactively address user pain points. You know when to shift between forward-looking feature work and production needs.

•
Communicate clearly and multiply your impact. Regular written and verbal communication, collaboration, and feedback are foundational skills you'll use daily. You'll mentor engineers, share knowledge, and delegate to help others grow - your goal is to make everyone around you more effective.

What you’ll bring to the role:

title: Head of Partnerships
description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, the ecosystem around Roboflow is becoming increasingly important. Customers don't deploy computer vision in isolation - they work with consulting partners, integrate with software platforms, and deploy onto cameras, edge devices, and other hardware.

We're looking for a Head of Partnerships to build the ecosystem that helps Roboflow reach more customers and bring more computer vision applications into production.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Partnerships at Roboflow has the potential to become a significant growth engine for the business.

We're looking for someone to own that opportunity end-to-end - identifying where partnerships can create leverage, developing the relationships, structuring the commercial model, launching joint initiatives, and ultimately turning those partnerships into measurable business results.

You'll build across three critical parts of our ecosystem: consulting and systems integration partners, hardware partners, and software/technology partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role today. You won't inherit a large partnerships organization or a mature playbook. You'll be the person building it.

That means personally sourcing partners, developing relationships, negotiating agreements, figuring out what makes the partnership valuable to both sides, enabling partners, working alongside Sales on opportunities, and creating the systems that eventually allow the function to scale.

As the ecosystem grows, you'll have the opportunity to shape what the Partnerships organization becomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build Roboflow's partnership strategy. Determine where partnerships can create the greatest leverage across distribution, customer acquisition, deployment, product adoption, and expansion - and translate that strategy into action.

Build our consulting and SI ecosystem. Develop relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, and implementation partners that can identify computer vision opportunities, bring Roboflow into customer engagements, and help deploy solutions at scale.

Develop strategic hardware partnerships. Build relationships across the hardware ecosystem - including cameras, edge compute, sensors, and other infrastructure our customers use to bring computer vision into the physical world.

Build software and technology partnerships. Identify platforms where integrations, co-selling, co-marketing, or broader strategic relationships can make Roboflow more valuable and expand our reach.

Personally take partnerships from idea to revenue. Source opportunities, develop the business case, build executive relationships, negotiate agreements, launch the partnership, and stay involved until it's producing meaningful results.

Create partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. Work closely with Sales to turn partnerships into real customer opportunities rather than relationships that exist primarily on paper.

Build joint go-to-market motions. Develop co-selling, referral, marketplace, integration, and co-marketing motions based on what makes sense for each partner and ecosystem.

Enable partners to successfully sell and deploy Roboflow. Work with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architects, and Delivery to give partners the technical and commercial knowledge they need to identify opportunities and successfully bring Roboflow to customers.

Develop the operating system for Partnerships. Establish how we prioritize partners, measure performance, manage pipeline, allocate internal resources, and determine when to invest more deeply in a relationship.

title: Video Editor

Our client is a dynamic content creation studio specializing in high-quality podcasts, videos, educational content, and digital media. They produce everything from short-form social content to full-length YouTube shows and professional podcast distributions.
They are seeking a skilled and versatile Video Editor who can excel in editing educational videos, event highlight reels, interview content, short-form social clips, and long-form podcast/YouTube episodes. This role is ideal for someone who works fast, communicates clearly, and understands modern content formats across all platforms.
Role Overview
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and efficient under tight deadlines. You must have a strong understanding of current social media trends, pacing for educational content, and long-form storytelling for YouTube and podcasts.
Key Responsibilities
1. Educational Video Editing (Primary Focus)

• Edit short educational videos using raw footage, talking-head content, screen recordings, or multi-camera setups.

• Select the best takes and build clear, engaging narratives.

• Sync high-quality audio with video.

• Add supporting visuals (graphics, lower thirds, on-screen text, B-roll).

• Apply sound effects, licensed music, color correction, and polished finishing touches.

• Add accurate captions for accessibility and sound-off viewing.

2. Short-Form Content Creation (Social Media Clips)

• Review long-form content (YouTube videos, interviews, podcasts) to identify compelling moments.

• Edit short-form clips (15-60 seconds) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, etc.

• Add dynamic captions, text treatments, motion elements, zooms/punch-ins, graphics, and sound design.

• Optimize pacing and hooks for maximum retention and virality.

3. Event Highlight Reels & Interview Content

• Edit high-energy event recaps using professional footage, transitions, text overlays, and music.

• Craft clean, polished interview-based videos with strong narrative flow.

• Incorporate B-roll, branded graphics, and color correction to maintain a consistent visual identity.

4. Long-Form Editing (Podcasts & YouTube)

• Edit full podcast episodes and long-form YouTube videos.

• Assemble multi-camera timelines, add graphics, incorporate B-roll, and create smooth pacing.

• Ensure brand consistency, storytelling clarity, and a clean, polished final output.

5. Audio Editing & Production

• Clean, level, and master audio tracks for podcast release (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, etc.).

• Handle noise reduction, EQ, compression, and clarity enhancement.

• Export final podcast audio in the required platforms’ technical specs.

6. Workflow & Communication

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet quick-turn deadlines.

• Deliver consistent updates, follow organized naming conventions, and maintain efficient file management.

• Communicate proactively about needs, blockers, and delivery timelines.

Requirements

• Proven video editing experience, specifically in:

• Educational videos

• Short-form social content

• Event highlight reels

• Interviews

• Long-form podcast or YouTube content

• Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following editing software's:

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Strong understanding of:

• Social trends and viral content structure

• Video codecs, formats, and aspect ratios

• Color correction and basic motion graphics

• Audio editing and mixing

• Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.

• Creative instincts and an eye for storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement.

• Additionally, we're looking for someone who's experienced in:

• Editing 10-bit footage

• Creating realistic AI characters of real people,

• Editing Talking head content

• Editing Event highlight reels

• Editing Real estate video content

title: Nurse Practitioner
description:
G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.
Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.
We know the current healthcare system isn’t meeting the needs of the modern Australian, and we reckon there’s a better, more holistic way. Our programs across hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management are easy, accessible and completely discreet.
More than a job
There’s nothing better than knowing the work you’re doing matters and makes a genuine difference. We’re pretty lucky that, at Mosh & Moshy, this is the norm rather than the exception.
We’re looking for two endorsed Nurse Practitioners to join our multidisciplinary clinical team and provide high-quality, evidence-based care at an advanced nursing level. Working remotely, you’ll help improve patients’ access to healthcare and support them throughout their treatment journey.
Reporting to our Clinical Operations Manager, you’ll combine strong clinical judgement with clear, compassionate communication to deliver a seamless telehealth experience.
What you’ll do
As a Nurse Practitioner, you’ll:

• Consult with new and existing patients via telephone and video, providing education, clinical advice and support

• Manage patients’ ongoing treatment plans, including assessing their response to treatment

• Prescribe appropriate medications and adjust treatment where clinically indicated and within your scope of practice

• Triage presenting symptoms and escalate or refer patients to the appropriate medical practitioner or pharmacist

• Collaborate with medical practitioners, pharmacists, allied health professionals and our wider Clinical Operations team

• Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and uphold our clinical governance and code-of-conduct requirements

• Share insights and feedback to continually improve our clinical systems, workflows and overall patient experience

Experience you’ll bring
To succeed in this role, you’ll have:

• A completed Master of Nursing and current endorsement as a Nurse Practitioner with AHPRA

• A current PBS prescriber number, or the ability to obtain one

• Recent experience working as a Nurse Practitioner within primary healthcare

• Strong clinical judgement and a commitment to safe, evidence-based, patient-centred care

• Confident, clear and empathetic communication skills, particularly in telephone and video consultations

• The ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical environment

• Confidence navigating digital clinical platforms, documentation systems and telehealth tools

• A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve patient care, systems and processes

What’s on offer
We hire people who share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of healthcare. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

• A fully remote role with the flexibility to work from home, within Australia

• Meaningful work that makes a real, positive difference in patients’ lives

• Plenty of opportunity to learn and grow as the company evolves

• Access to up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Two additional paid company closure days each year

• Two days of purpose leave for mental health or learning and development

• Access to on-demand learning through Go1

• EAP support and online wellbeing programs

• ClassPass credit discounts

• Discounts across a range of Mosh & Moshy products and services

• A creative, friendly and collaborative team

Better, together
Everyone is different, and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe our differences generate better ideas, bring valuable perspectives and help us represent the people we care for.
If you’re excited by the opportunity but don’t tick every single box, we’d still love to hear from you.

description:

• Ability to work cross-collaboratively in a highly matrixed organization.

• Effective verbal, written and presentation communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Role Overview
The Cybersecurity Analyst is a hands-on operational role within the Cyber Operations team, responsible for frontline security monitoring, incident response support, exposure management validation, and compliance evidence. Working under the direction of the Director, Cyber Operations and senior engineers, the Analyst is the execution layer of KLDiscovery 's security program monitoring what matters, responding when it counts, and keeping the team's operational processes running reliably. This is a remote opportunity with a clear growth path toward Sr. Cybersecurity Analyst.
Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Alert Triage

• Serve as first-line eyes on the environment validating and escalating CrowdStrike MDR-confirmed findings, reviewing MDR outputs, assessing context, and ensuring accurate internal escalation to the Engineers and Director

• Monitor security alerts from tools operating outside MDR scope
Triage alerts for AI tool misuse, anomalous AI-related activity, and other emerging threat patterns as directed by the Security Manager

• Flag SIEM and identity health monitoring gaps, anomalies, and coverage issues to the engineering team - you are the first to notice when something looks wrong or missing

Incident Response Support

• Serve as first-line support during security incidents like gathering evidence, documenting timelines, executing containment steps, and supporting the Security Manager through the full incident lifecycle

• Conduct initial technical investigations to identify root cause of intrusions, anomalies, or policy violations

• Maintain incident records, post-incident documentation, and lessons-learned notes to a standard that supports compliance evidence and future response improvement

• Participate in on-call rotation to ensure coverage outside core business hours for escalated MDR findings or active incidents

Vulnerability & Exposure Management Support

• Monitor the CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management dashboard tracking open findings, flagging severity changes, and keeping remediation status records current to support the engineer who owns the program

• Follow up on patch deployment failures identifying affected systems and coordinating with IT on remediation timelines as directed by the engineering team

• Support third-party penetration test logistics, internal scheduling communication, evidence gathering, and remediation ticket tracking under the direction of the engineer coordinating the engagement

• Maintain accurate and current exposure tracking records so the engineering team always has clean data for prioritization decisions and compliance reporting

Compliance & Audit Support

• Gather and maintain technical evidence for compliance frameworks and internal audits

• Support internal audit and pre-assessment readiness reviews, organizing evidence packages and ensuring documentation is audit-ready at all times, not reconstructed at assessment time

• Assist the GRC team with technical control evidence, gap tracking, and remediation documentation

• Maintain documentation that supports annual security compliance attestations relevant to assigned business units

Qualifications

Experience

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in a security operation, IT, or closely related technical role

• Practical experience with security monitoring, alert triage, or incident response in a corporate environment

• Familiarity with MDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon Complete or equivalent) is a strong plus

• Working knowledge of common security tools or ticketing systems(Remedy or equivalent)

Technical Knowledge

• Understanding of core security domains sufficient to execute assigned tasks independently: access management, encryption, network security, vulnerability management, and incident response

• Basic familiarity with cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including IAM, logging, and posture monitoring

• Foundational understanding of AppSec concepts is a meaningful differ

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Associate Director, Paid Social
description:
Associate Director, Paid Social

London, hybrid

 

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Associate Director, Paid Social, you will serve as the strategic mastermind and operational anchor for our largest, enterprise-level account in London. You are a seasoned performance media leader who balances high-level strategic vision with deep technical expertise in performance social, measurement structures and paid social processes.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated team of Senior Managers and Managers, translating complex data and consumer journeys into high-yield, full-funnel paid social strategies. You will sit at the intersection of performance excellence, client leadership, and cross-channel growth - ensuring our client’s ‘family of apps’ stay ahead in a rapidly evolving, automated social landscape.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic Leadership & Channel Growth

• Drive Full-Funnel Strategy: Own the overarching paid social roadmap for a global client, aligning social budgets and tactics with overarching business priorities.

• Master Platform Mechanics: Direct performance strategy across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, and YouTube. Champion platform automation (e.g., Meta Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns / ASC+) while maintaining strategic controls over best practices and creative messaging.

• Measurement & Incrementality: Lead advanced measurement frameworks in partnership with data teams, implementing multiple complex single-cell, multi-cell, child and nested studies. 

• Integrated Growth & Upsell: Collaborate with internal US counterparts to identify holistic growth levers, drive strategic upsells - to ensure that we are delivering a cohesive multi-channel strategy globally.

Client Governance & Senior Stakeholder Management

• Trusted Strategic Advisor: Serve as the primary senior strategist for executive-level client stakeholders, translating complex performance data and algorithm shifts into clear, compelling narratives.

• Escalation Authority: Act as the ultimate escalation point across your client portfolio, proactively mitigating performance dips, resolving channel conflicts, and navigating complex operational challenges.

• Budget Oversight & Forecasting: Maintain total accountability for multi-million-pound media budgets, accurate forecasting, quarterly pacing, and commercial delivery.

People Leadership, Delivery & Innovation

• Build & Mentor Talent: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of paid social managers and buyers. Drive retention, establish clear career development paths, and coach line managers on effective delegation and team leadership.

• Enforce & Evolve Standards: Implement robust QA frameworks, workflow processes (e.g., Asana, internal platform auditing), and campaign governance to ensure flawless execution and zero-error delivery.

• Test & Learn Culture: Build and scale a rigorous testing framework across the practice, leveraging platform innovation, previous learnings and testing priorities outlined in the strategic roadmap. 

 

WHAT YOU BRING

• 7+ years of hands-on paid social planning & activation experience, with at least 3 years managing client relationships and leading direct reports/team structures of 10+ people.

• Expert-level knowledge of Meta Ads Manager (biggest priority), TikTok Ads Manager, Pinterest, Snapchat, and platform automation capabilities.

• Proven track record of setting, defending, and hitting strict KPIs. Fluent in advanced measurement, Excel

title: Customer Experience Improvement Manager
description:
About the role

We are seeking a Customer Experience Improvement Manager (CX Improvement Manager) to lead the end-to-end implementation and optimisation of high-impact customer experience initiatives. This newly created role will build upon our existing quality audit and failure demand analysis and translate them into proactive, systemic initiatives that address root causes and prevent recurring customer friction.

The (CX Improvement Manager) will identify the root causes of both reasons that drive users to seek help (i.e. contact our Customer Service teams) and also reasons for customer dissatisfaction (DSAT). Using these insights the role holder will partner cross-functionally with CS, Quality, Operations, Product and Tech teams to project-manage operational solutions - such as proactive incident communications, automated surge protocols, improvements to our AI Virtual Assistant and social media engagement playbooks.

If you are a data-driven operations specialist who thrives on solving systemic friction, building scalable workflows, and directly moving CX metrics, this role is for you.

What you'll be doing

• Strategic Program & Project Management

Execute High-Impact CX Initiatives: Project-manage core quality programs

30-60-90 Day Impact Roadmaps: Design and execute structured roadmaps focused on addressing top customer contact and DSAT drivers (e.g. bet settlement queries, policy related concerns and deposit/withdrawal challenges).

Maintain, triage and manage (i.e. verify, categorise, prioritise) the operational backlog of bugs, intent gaps, and UX improvements for the AI Virtual Assistant, serving as the bridge between frontline CS teams and Product to drive continuous bot performance.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Alignment

Product & Tech Integration: Partner with CS, Product, Ops and Tech teams to implement initiatives like dynamic, event-driven in-app alerts and automated IVR messaging to deflect/intercept inbound ticket surges before they reach live agents.

• Metric Ownership & Performance Analytics

CSAT & DSAT Management: Own overall CSAT/DSAT performance, linking root causes for dissatisfaction to improvement initiatives and measuring the direct benefit of changes made.

Social Media & ORM Optimization: Revamp Online Reputation Management (ORM) playbooks for X (Twitter), Telegram and Facebook, transitioning teams from highly manual and robotic responses to more automated and efficient ways of working whilst retaining a context-aware engagement approach.

What you'll bring

• Experience: 5+ years in Customer Operations, Quality Management or CX Project Management, preferably in high-volume environments (Fintech, iGaming, E-commerce or Tech)

• Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Tech, and Customer Operations using methodologies like Agile or Lean.

• Data & Analytics Proficiency: Strong proficiency in customer support analytics, queue management metrics (AHT, FCR, ART, Shrinkage), and identifying trends within unstructured customer feedback (verbatims/DSAT surveys).

• Technical Savvy: Comfort with API-driven integrations, IVR routing logic, automated helpdesk workflows and social media management tools.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex technical outages into simple, empathetic customer-facing copy and clear executive updates.

Even better if

• Prior experience operating in high-volatility, real-time event industries (e.g., sports betting, live payments, or trading platforms).

• Direct experience writing SOPs, designing automated ticket routing workflows, and establishing disaster recovery/surge protocols.

• Certified 6 Sigma Green or Blackbelt

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise, Asset Management

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is the AI platform trusted by the world's leading law firms and corporate legal teams, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI. Now we're bringing that to asset management - and this role owns it. We're building the team that will define how the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, and institutional funds adopt AI. - Conduct tailored demos and presentations that connect Harvey's product directly to the workflows and pain points specific to financial services buyers.

- Document what works. This team is building the asset management playbook from scratch, and your learnings will directly shape how we scale the motion.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience selling complex software or professional services into financial services (ideally asset management, private equity, or institutional funds). You understand how these firms are structured and how buying decisions get made.

- Proven ability to run a global or named account relationship - you've been the person a firm calls, not just the person who closes a deal and moves on. Ideally you've navigated a fund relationship or portfolio company motion.

- Background in enterprise software sales, management consulting, or a combination - we're intentionally mixing profiles on this team. If you've unlocked a major financial services account or come from a firm that advises these organizations, we want to talk to you.

- Comfortable operating in a motion that's still being defined. You're a builder who can prospect independently, iterate on messaging, and contribute to the team's collective learning.

Tu te joindras à l'équipe Canal EMEA de ShareGate : un groupe tissé serré, ambitieux sur le plan commercial, qui carbure à la confiance, à l'autonomie et à l'absence d'ego. Tu collaboreras aussi au besoin avec les spécialistes des ventes techniques, le marketing canal et les opérations de revenus. ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, EMEA based in London to lead Exa's marketing across Europe.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Europe and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. EMEA is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.

Sales coverage is coming online across the UK and EU. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in London, Berlin, Zurich, and Amsterdam.

This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.

Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.

This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.

This role is based in-person in London, with regular travel across EMEA and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 

EMEA MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for EMEA, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the EMEA marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.

 

GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET

Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across the UK, EU, Middle East and Africa. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.

 

PIPELINE AND DEMAND

Own EMEA pipeline targets. Build the programs that create qualified opportunities and move them through the cycle: account-based campaigns, executive dinners, a small number of high-value trade shows, reactivation of any stalled pipeline, and webinars or localized content. Use pipeline and conversion data to shift investment toward what works. Success is measured by pipeline and by cost per opportunity.

title: Supply Chain Systems Support Analyst
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 

Supply Chain Systems Support Analyst

Anduril Industries

 

About the Team

Anduril's Supply Chain organization is building the systems infrastructure to scale procurement, planning, and logistics across a rapidly growing defense technology portfolio. Within this organization, the Digital Supply Chain function is responsible for optimizing supply chain operations through implementation, management, and continuous improvement of the digital platforms that power sourcing, inventory, fulfillment, and supplier management. The team ensures that supply chain processes are efficient, scalable, and integrated with the latest industry standards.

About the Role

As a Supply Chain Systems Specialist, your primary responsibility is to respond to reported supply chain system incidents submitted by internal stakeholders across Anduril's global supply chain user base. You will own the intake, evaluation, debug, escalation, communications, and tracking of reported incidents across the platforms that support procurement, purchasing, planning, inventory, and logistics operations. The user base supported by this role includes supply chain analysts, procurement specialists, buyers, planners, and program managers. Support case duration and technical complexity will range widely.

Beyond reactive support, you will be embedded in supply chain operations, working cross-functionally with Procurement, Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, IT, Engineering, Business Systems, and other stakeholders to solve complex systems problems that span multiple teams and don't fall neatly into any single domain. You bring structure to ambiguity, think in systems, and drive solutions where others see only complexity.

What You'll Do

Triage, Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution

• Serve as the critical bridge between supply chain operations and digital supply chain systems (ERP, PR apps) identifying and resolving software issues that impact supply chain efficiency.

• Monitor intake of reported software problems across multiple supply chain platforms and triage based on urgency, impact, and scope.

• Conduct root cause analysis by observing actual supply chain processes and how they interact with digital systems to identify disconnects between software functionality and operational needs.

• Escalate to engineering support when required and provide clear operational context to software development teams about supply chain realities and downstream impacts.

• Develop workarounds and best practices that accommodate both system limitations and supply chain requirements, minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.

• Proactively identify potential unreported problems by regularly analyzing system data patterns, monitoring supply chain KPIs, and reviewing process adherence across platforms.

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Systems Thinking

• Step into high-priority problems that span multiple teams and systems, bringing structure to ambiguity and driving resolution without waiting for clear ownership or prescribed solutions.

• Project manage across large, cross-functional groups of stakeholders-leading meetings, managing communications, and driving alignment toward solutions amid challenging deadlines and moving milestones.
